display_name: Normalized CodeQL leads and retained databases for one language
validation_rules: one node per CodeQL language (ADR-0023); a language absent from the checkout publishes SKIPPED not-applicable-language-absent
the pinned audit-codeql image runs one B13 container per plan row with network none, a read-only target and one writable scratch mount
CodeQL tool metadata (bundle sha256 pinned by image.json and the Dockerfile, lane script hash, query suites) and the B16 image identity are part of the input fingerprint
databases are created with --build-mode none (cpp additionally traced per accepted native unit) and analyzed with the bundled <lang>-security-extended suite; nothing is downloaded
a compiled language that cannot be built (Go) or has no pinned suite (Rust) is a coverage gap, never a failure

every completed lane's database is retained outside the attempt and published as a hash-bound pointer (tree sha256, files, bytes, bundle version, build mode, source snapshot); consumers re-hash before use
the caller-held B13 result sha256 is re-verified on every read and the normalized result is re-derived from the receipts
raw SARIF messages and snippets remain in the immutable tool attempt; leads carry rule id, the pinned rule name, CWE tags, fresh hashed source citations and lines
a lane that times out, runs out of memory or exits non-zero is a coverage gap (ADR-0013); canceled or gate-refused containers block
results that cite no regular checkout file line are dropped and counted as a gap
records are static-analysis evidence leads, not verified findings, severities or observed runtime state
latest failed attempt blocks older accepted output
